The decoder of a segmentation network uses it to enlarge small feature maps layer by layer back to the size of the picture.

t.zh: 前几章的网络越往后图越小：池化、隔点取样一层层把 16×16 缩成几个数，最后回答「这是什么」。可要是问「每个像素是什么」，答案得和原图一样大。
t.en: The networks of earlier chapters make the picture smaller and smaller: pooling and downsampling shrink 16×16 to a few numbers that answer "what is this?". But to ask "what is every pixel?", the answer has to be as big as the original.

t.zh: 新原件<part-ref to="part:zeroUp"></part-ref>把图放大一倍：每个像素放在 2×2 的左上角，另外三格补 0。
t.en: The new primitive <part-ref to="part:zeroUp"></part-ref> doubles the size: each pixel goes in the top left of a 2×2 block, and the other three cells are 0.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：把 8×8 的图放大成 16×16，每个像素变成一样的 2×2 一块。
t.en: Your task in this level: enlarge an 8×8 picture to 16×16, every pixel becoming a 2×2 block of the same value.

brief.zh: 把 8×8 的图放大成 16×16：每个像素变成 2×2 的一小块，四格都一样。
brief.en: Enlarge an 8×8 picture to 16×16: every pixel becomes a 2×2 block, all four cells the same.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="part:zeroUp"></part-ref>把每个像素放在 2×2 的左上角。剩下三格从哪里取数？
hint.en: <part-ref to="part:zeroUp"></part-ref> puts each pixel in the top left of its 2×2. Where do the other three cells get their number?

after.zh: 换一个核，同一个转置卷积就从「一格复制四格」变成了平滑放大。在网络里，这个核是学出来的：解码器自己学会怎样放大才最有用。
after.en: Change the kernel and the same transposed convolution goes from "copy one cell to four" to smooth enlargement. In a network this kernel is learnt: the decoder learns for itself how best to enlarge.

t.zh: 托盘里的「转置卷积」先补零放大一倍，再用一个 3×3 的核走一遍，核可以自己填。
t.en: The Transposed convolution in the tray zero-upsamples to twice the size, then runs a 3×3 kernel over it; you fill in the kernel yourself.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：放大得平滑一些，规则在说明里。
t.en: Your task in this level: enlarge more smoothly; the rule is in the brief.

brief.zh: 还是放大一倍，这次要平滑：原来的像素原样留下，空出来的格子取左右（或上下）两个原像素的平均，角上的格子取四个的平均。
brief.en: Twice the size again, this time smoothly: the original pixels stay as they are, an empty cell takes the average of the two original pixels on either side (or above and below), and a corner cell the average of four.

hint.zh: 一个原像素要分给周围哪些格子、各分多少？
hint.en: Which surrounding cells does one original pixel go to, and how much to each?

after.zh: 这叫最大反池化：编码器池化时记下最大值在哪，解码器放大时放回原处，细节就不会被抹到整块上。SegNet 就是这么做的。
after.en: This is max unpooling: the encoder remembers where each maximum was when pooling, and the decoder puts it back there when enlarging, so details are not smeared over the whole block. SegNet works like this.

t.zh: 最大池化留下每个 2×2 块里最大的那个数，却没记下它在块里的哪一格。放大回来时，它该放在哪？
t.en: Max pooling keeps the largest number of each 2×2 block, but does not record which cell of the block it was in. When enlarging back, where should it go?

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：把池化后的值放回它原来的那一格，块里其余格子是 0。池化前的图也给你。
t.en: Your task in this level: put each pooled value back in the cell it came from, with the rest of the block 0. The picture before pooling is given too.

desc.zh: 把池化后的每个值放回池化前它所在的那一格，其余格子为 0。
desc.en: Puts each pooled value back in the cell it came from before pooling; every other cell is 0.

brief.zh: 每个 2×2 块的最大值被池化成了一格。把它放回块里原来那一格，块里其余三格是 0。
brief.en: Each 2×2 block's largest value was pooled into one cell. Put it back in the cell of the block it came from, with the other three cells of the block 0.

hint.zh: 先把小图放大到块那么大；块里哪一格和放大后的值一样大？
hint.en: First enlarge the small picture to block size; which cell of the block equals the enlarged value?

after.zh: 池化把位置丢掉了一部分，反池化把它找回来：亮点在 2×2 块里的哪一格，信息还在池化前的图里。
after.en: Pooling throws part of the position away, and unpooling gets it back: which cell of the 2×2 block the dot was in is still in the picture before pooling.

t.zh: 托盘里的<part-ref to="own-9-3"></part-ref>把池化后的每个值放回池化前它所在的那一格，其余格子为 0。
t.en: The <part-ref to="own-9-3"></part-ref> in the tray puts each pooled value back in the cell it came from before pooling; every other cell is 0.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：池化一张亮点图再放大回来，每个亮点要回到原处。
t.en: Your task in this level: pool a picture of bright dots and enlarge it back, with every dot returning to its place.

brief.zh: 一张稀疏的亮点图先做 2×2 最大池化，再放大回 16×16，每个亮点要回到原来的位置。
brief.en: A picture of sparse bright dots goes through 2×2 max pooling, then back up to 16×16, and every dot must return to where it was.

hint.zh: 一放大，每个点就糊成一整块。
hint.en: Enlarge it and every dot smears into a whole block.

after.zh: 分两类、各求中心、再分：这是 k 均值的一步。重复几步，分界就停在两堆像素之间。
after.en: Split into two, find each centre, split again: that is one step of k-means. Repeat a few steps and the boundary settles between the two heaps of pixels.

t.zh: 没有人告诉机器哪些是前景、哪些是背景时，它能不能自己把像素分成几堆？
t.en: When nobody tells the machine what is foreground and what is background, can it split the pixels into heaps by itself?

t.zh: 一个办法：先随便定一条亮度分界，按它把像素分成两类，看看两类各自的平均，再挪分界。
t.en: One way: draw a boundary in brightness anywhere, split the pixels into two classes by it, look at each class's average, then move the boundary.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：按说明里的规则，算出挪一次以后的新分界。
t.en: Your task in this level: by the rule in the brief, work out the new boundary after one move.

desc.zh: 按分界 m 把值分成两类，输出两类平均值的正中间。
desc.en: Splits the values into two classes at the boundary m and outputs halfway between the two class averages.

brief.zh: 把像素按亮度分成两类：亮于分界 m 的一类，其余一类。算出两类各自的平均亮度，输出它们正中间的新分界。
brief.en: Split the pixels into two classes by brightness: those brighter than the boundary m, and the rest. Work out each class's average brightness and output the new boundary halfway between them.

hint.zh: 一类的平均 = 这一类像素的亮度之和 ÷ 这一类的像素数。<part-ref to="mean"></part-ref>除以的是全部像素数，两个平均相除就约掉了。
hint.en: A class's average = the sum of its pixels' brightness ÷ the number of its pixels. <part-ref to="mean"></part-ref> divides by the number of all the pixels, which cancels when one average is divided by another.

after.zh: 不用告诉它什么是前景，k 均值自己把像素分成两堆。可它只看亮度：亮度一样的两样东西，它分不开。
after.en: Without being told what the foreground is, k-means splits the pixels into two heaps by itself. But it looks only at brightness: two things of the same brightness, it cannot tell apart.

t.zh: 托盘里的<part-ref to="own-9-5"></part-ref>按分界 m 把值分成两类，输出两类平均值的正中间。
t.en: The <part-ref to="own-9-5"></part-ref> in the tray splits the values into two classes at the boundary m and outputs halfway between the two class averages.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：从起始分界出发走三步，再把每个像素分成两类。
t.en: Your task in this level: take three steps from the starting boundary, then split every pixel into two classes.

caption.en: Set 2: a strip on the right

brief.zh: 从给定的起始分界出发做三步 k 均值，再按最后的分界把每个像素分成两类：亮的一类输出 1。
brief.en: Starting from the given boundary, take three k-means steps, then split every pixel into two classes by the final boundary: output 1 for the bright class.

hint.zh: 起始的分界可能离得很远。
hint.en: The starting boundary may be a long way off.

after.zh: 缩小时几格平均，噪点互相抵消；判断完再放大回来：这就是编码器—解码器。代价是边界只能对齐到块：比块还细的东西，缩小时就丢了。
after.en: Shrinking averages several cells so the grain cancels out; decide, then enlarge back: this is an encoder–decoder. The price is that boundaries can only line up with the blocks: anything finer than a block is lost in the shrinking.

t.zh: 显微镜下数细胞、量细胞，第一步是标出每个像素是不是细胞。可切片上满是噪点。
t.en: To count and measure cells under a microscope, the first step is marking whether every pixel is a cell. But the slide is full of grain.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：标出细胞（1）和背景（0）。
t.en: Your task in this level: mark the cells (1) and the background (0).

brief.zh: 显微镜下的细胞，噪点很重。标出细胞（1）和背景（0）。
brief.en: Cells under a microscope, with heavy grain. Mark the cells (1) and the background (0).

hint.zh: 一格一格看，噪点会骗过门槛。几格一起看呢？
hint.en: Looked at cell by cell, the grain fools the threshold. What about several cells at once?

after.zh: 把放大回来的粗结果和原尺寸的细结果合起来：粗的一路挡住噪点，细的一路留下细节。这条从编码器直接连到解码器的线叫跳连，U-Net 每一层都有。
after.en: Combine the coarse result enlarged back with the fine result at full size: the coarse path keeps out the grain, the fine path keeps the detail. This line straight from encoder to decoder is called a skip connection, and U-Net has one at every level.

t.zh: 细胞常常挤在一起，中间只隔一条极细的缝。数细胞时，缝丢了，两个就算成一个。
t.en: Cells often crowd together with only a very thin gap between them. When counting, lose the gap and two count as one.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：标出细胞，细胞之间的缝要留着。
t.en: Your task in this level: mark the cells, keeping the gaps between them.

brief.zh: 挨在一起的细胞之间只隔一条一像素的暗缝。标出细胞，缝要留着（0）。
brief.en: Touching cells are separated only by a dark gap one pixel wide. Mark the cells, and keep the gaps (0).

hint.zh: 缩小再放大的那条路看不见一像素的缝。原图里还看得见。
hint.en: The shrink-then-enlarge path cannot see a one-pixel gap. The original picture still can.

label.en: Two in a row, gap elsewhere

after.zh: 自适应的分界、去噪的粗路径、保细节的跳连：一个小小的 U-Net 式流水线。真实的细胞分割网络把每一步都换成学出来的卷积，结构还是这个样子。
after.en: An adaptive boundary, a coarse path that removes grain, a skip connection that keeps detail: a small U-Net-style pipeline. Real cell-segmentation networks replace every step with learnt convolutions, but the structure stays the same.

t.zh: 一批切片来自不同的显微镜、不同的染色，有的整体暗，有的整体亮。
t.en: A batch of slides comes from different microscopes and stains: some dark overall, some bright.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：每张切片都标出细胞，缝要留着。
t.en: Your task in this level: mark the cells on every slide, keeping the gaps.

brief.zh: 一批显微镜切片，每张的亮度和对比度都不一样，细胞挨在一起。标出细胞，细胞之间的缝要留着。
brief.en: A batch of microscope slides, each with its own brightness and contrast, with cells touching. Mark the cells, and keep the gaps between them.

hint.zh: 固定的门槛，在暗的切片上和亮的切片上不会都对。
hint.en: A fixed threshold cannot be right on both dark slides and bright ones.

body.zh: 视觉完备把一门计算机视觉课做成了一串关卡。没有讲课：每关给你一组输入和期望的输出，你用元件搭出能把前者变成后者的东西，测试全部通过就算过关。
body.en: Vision Complete turns a computer vision course into a series of levels. There are no lectures: each level gives you some inputs and the outputs it expects, you build something from parts that turns one into the other, and when every test passes, the level is done.

body.zh: 开场时你是刚上电的探测器 V-0：传感器把世界变成一格格数字，可你还读不懂它们。你要做的，是一步步学会读懂这些数字。
body.en: You start as Probe V-0, just powered on: your sensor turns the world into a grid of numbers that you cannot read yet. Your job is to learn, step by step, to read them.

body.zh: 进度存在这台设备的浏览器里：关掉页面再回来，通过的关和搭好的电路都还在。
body.en: Your progress is kept in this browser on this device: close the page and come back, and the levels you passed and the circuits you built are still there.

body.zh: 地图上每一章是一条走线，关卡是线上的焊点，旁边的小图标说明这一关是搭电路还是机关台。每章对应课上的一两讲，标题下写着这一章要回答的问题。
body.en: On the map each chapter is a trace and its levels are pads along it; a small icon beside each says whether it is a circuit or a bench. Each chapter follows one or two lectures of the course, and under its title is the question the chapter sets out to answer.

body.zh: 一关的前置关卡都通过后，它才会打开；通过的打勾，没打开的带锁。「继续」直接带你去下一个还没通过的关卡。打开「全部解锁」，任意一关都能不按顺序直接玩，进度照常记录。
body.en: A level opens once the levels before it are passed; passed levels are ticked and closed ones show a padlock. “Continue” takes you straight to the first level you have not passed yet. Turn on “Unlock all” to play any level in any order; progress is still recorded.

body.zh: 在关卡里，顶栏的「关卡」按钮打开一份关卡列表，可以直接换关，不必回地图。
body.en: Inside a level, the “Levels” button in the top bar opens a list of levels, so you can switch levels without going back to the map.

body.zh: 大多数关卡要你搭一个电路。「输入」元件装着关卡给的数据，「输出」元件是你交出去的结果，元件上还标着装的是图像、波形还是数值。两者之间放元件，用线连起来。
body.en: Most levels ask you to build a circuit. The “Input” part holds the data the level gives you and the “Output” part is the result you hand in; each part also says whether it carries an image, a waveform or a number. In between you place parts and wire them together.

body.zh: 每个元件有一个或几个输入口（比如 a、b，或者左、右），只有一个输出点。线从一块的输出点连到另一块的输入口：一个输出可以接给很多处，一个输入口只读一根线。线不能绕成圈，因为一块不能等自己算完再算自己。
body.en: Every part has one or more input ports (such as a and b, or left and right) and a single output dot. A wire runs from one block’s output dot to another block’s input port: an output can feed many places, but each input port reads from one wire. Wires cannot form a loop, since a block cannot wait for itself to finish.

body.zh: 有的元件带设置，比如乘几、门槛多高、往哪个方向挪、九个权重。改一个设置，所有元件上的结果马上跟着变；输入没接满的元件会提示还缺输入。
body.en: Some parts have settings: what to multiply by, how high a threshold is, which way to shift, nine weights. Change a setting and the results on every part update at once; a part with an input left unwired says it is missing one.

body.zh: 每个元件都显示它在当前选中的那组测试上算出的结果，所以你可以沿着电路一路看图像怎样变化。
body.en: Every part shows what it produces on the currently selected test, so you can follow the image as it changes along the circuit.

body.zh: 每关有几组测试，每组是一份输入和一份期望的输出。你的输出要和期望逐格比对：每格允许差一点点（容差），尺寸也必须一样；有的关允许少数几格出错。
body.en: Each level has a few tests, and each test is an input with its expected output. Your output is compared with the expected one cell by cell: each cell may be off by a tiny amount (the tolerance), and the size must match too. Some levels let a few cells be wrong.

body.zh: 元件上的结果随时更新，但过没过要按「运行测试」才算。测试全部通过，这一关就完成了；没过时，第一组没过的测试会被选中。之后只要改动电路，就要重新测试。
body.en: The results on the parts update all the time, but whether they pass only counts once you press “Run tests”. When every test passes, the level is complete; if not, the first failing test is selected for you. After any change to the circuit, the tests need running again.

body.zh: 很多关还有隐藏测试：每次运行都一起检查，但只告诉你有几组没过，通关后才公开。看得见的测试全过、隐藏测试却没过，说明电路可能只对这几张图凑巧成立。
body.en: Many levels also have hidden tests: they are checked on every run, but you only learn how many failed, and they are shown once you pass. If every visible test passes but a hidden one fails, your circuit may only happen to work on those particular pictures.

body.zh: 测试面板列出每组测试，点一组看它的详情：输入、期望、你的输出，以及一张误差图，标出哪些格子超出了容差。没过的那组会写明原因，比如有几个像素超出容差，或者尺寸不对。
body.en: The test panel lists every test; pick one to see its details: the input, the expected output, your output, and an error map marking which cells are outside the tolerance. A failing test says why, such as how many pixels are outside the tolerance, or that the size is wrong.

body.zh: 把指针停在图上，可以读出每一格的数值和期望值。输出是一个数时，期望、允许范围和你的读数画在同一条刻度上；输出是一行时，画成曲线，期望曲线外围有一条允许带。
body.en: Hover over a picture to read the value in each cell and the value expected there. When the output is a single number, the expected value, the allowed range and your reading are drawn on one scale; when it is a single row, it is drawn as a curve, with an allowed band round the expected curve.

body.zh: 选中哪一组测试，板上所有元件就都显示这一组的结果。手机上点顶上的测试标签切换，详情在底栏的「测试详情」里。
body.en: Whichever test is selected, every part on the board shows its results for that test. On a phone, tap the test tabs along the top to switch, and find the details under “Test details” in the bottom bar.

body.zh: 第一次进一关时会弹出几页「引言」：这一关在讲什么、现实里哪里用得到、有什么新元件，以及动手前值得想的问题。之后随时可以点顶栏的「引言」再看。
body.en: The first time you enter a level, a few pages of “Intro” open: what the level is about, where it shows up in the real world, any new parts, and a question worth thinking about before you start. You can reopen it any time from “Intro” in the top bar.

body.zh: 任务说明下面有「提示」按钮，卡住时再点开。提示说得比较直接，先自己试一试收获更大。
body.en: Below the task there is a “Hint” button for when you are stuck. Hints are fairly direct, so it pays to try on your own first.

body.zh: 过关时，通过窗口会用几句话点明刚才发生了什么。它提到的概念，大多在这本百科里有词条。
body.en: When you pass, the passed window sums up in a few lines what just happened. Most of the ideas it names have an entry in this encyclopedia.

body.zh: 电脑上是一张工作台：左边是任务、提示和元件栏，中间是画布，右边是测试面板。点元件栏里的元件，它就放到画布的空处；从元件右侧的圆点拖线到另一个元件；选中元件或连线后按 Delete 删除。
body.en: On a desktop the screen is a workbench: the task, hint and parts list on the left, the board in the middle and the test panel on the right. Click a part in the list to drop it in a free spot on the board; drag a wire from the dot on the right of a part to another part; select a part or wire and press Delete to remove it.

body.zh: 拖动画布的空白处可以平移，按住 ⌘/Ctrl 滚动或双指捏合可以缩放，角上的按钮能把整个电路缩放到合适大小。
body.en: Drag an empty part of the board to pan, hold ⌘/Ctrl and scroll (or pinch) to zoom, and the corner buttons fit the whole circuit into view.

body.zh: 手机上是一块竖着的电路板：输入在最上面，输出在最下面，中间是两列格位。点底部托盘里的元件放进空格，点两个圆点就连上线，点已接好的输入口就拆掉；按住一块可以换格子，拖回托盘就是拿掉。点一块打开它的面板，看说明、改设置。
body.en: On a phone it is a tall circuit board: the inputs at the top, the outputs at the bottom and two columns of slots in between. Tap a part in the tray at the bottom to drop it into a free slot, tap two dots to wire them, and tap a wired input to unplug it; hold a block to move it to another slot, or drag it back onto the tray to remove it. Tap a block to open its panel, with its description and settings.

body.zh: 手机的底栏有「撤销」、测试详情、「清空」（要点两次）和「运行测试」。两种布局改的是同一份电路。
body.en: The phone’s bottom bar has “Undo”, the test details, “Clear” (tap twice) and “Run tests”. Both layouts edit the same circuit.

body.zh: 手机的电路板上，元件一多，线就会交错成一团。板子右上角的接线开关在三种显示之间轮换：「全部接线」、「隐藏输入接线」（不画从输入元件出发的线）和「隐藏接线」。
body.en: On the phone’s circuit board, wires soon tangle once there are a few parts. The wire switch at the top right of the board cycles through three displays: “All wires”, “No input wires” (the wires leaving the input parts are not drawn) and “No wires”.

body.zh: 把线藏起来，电路并没有变。每个接好的输入口旁有个小标签，写着它读的是哪个元件；选中一个圆点时，它所在那个元件的线照样会画出来。
body.en: Hiding wires does not change the circuit. Each wired input has a small tag beside it naming the part it reads from, and while a dot is picked, the wires of its own part are still drawn.

body.zh: 这个选择记在这台设备的浏览器里，换一关也不变。
body.en: The choice is remembered in this browser and stays the same from level to level.

body.zh: 不是每关都要搭电路。机关台是一张可以动手的图：拖动、拧旋钮、推推杆，图马上跟着变，台上实时标出目标有没有达到。
body.en: Not every level is a circuit. A bench is a figure you can work with your hands: drag things, turn knobs, push sliders, and the figure changes at once, showing live whether the goals are met.

body.zh: 还有一种台上只放一个黑箱：挑测试图喂进去，比较进去和出来的样子，再回答它做了什么。先实验、再下结论，是摸清陌生工具最可靠的办法。
body.en: One kind of bench holds just a black box: pick test pictures to feed in, compare what goes in with what comes out, then say what it did. Experimenting before concluding is the most reliable way to get to know an unfamiliar tool.

body.zh: 过关常会解锁新元件，通过窗口里会列出来。弄清楚的黑箱会变成你的<part-ref to="shift"></part-ref>；亲手搭出的东西，也常会变成现成的元件，之后直接拿来用，不必再关心里面怎么搭。
body.en: Passing a level often unlocks a new part, listed in the passed window. A black box you have figured out becomes your <part-ref to="shift"></part-ref>, and what you build by hand often becomes a ready-made part too, used directly from then on without your having to think about what is inside.

body.zh: 解锁的也可能是某个设置里的一个新选项。
body.en: An unlock can also be a new option in a setting.

body.zh: 每关的元件栏只摆出这一关给的元件。地图上的「元件箱」列出游戏里所有元件，已拿到的点亮并附说明。有的关要你亲手搭出某样东西，这时现成的那个会暂时收起来。
body.en: Each level’s parts list holds only the parts that level offers. The “Parts” box on the map lists every part in the game, with the ones you have earned lit up and described. When a level asks you to build something by hand, the ready-made version is put away for that level.

body.zh: 搭电路的关卡有两项评分：节点是你放了几个元件，计算量是每算出一个输出像素要做多少次运算。计算量越小越好；一样大时，元件少的更好。
body.en: Circuit levels are scored on two things: parts is how many parts you placed, and cost is how many arithmetic operations it takes to compute one output pixel. Lower cost is better; at equal cost, fewer parts wins.

body.zh: 每关记下你的最好成绩，地图上已通过的关会显示它。评分一般不影响过关，可以过后再回来优化。
body.en: Your best score for each level is kept and shown on the map beside the passed level. The score does not usually affect passing, so you can come back later and improve it.

body.zh: 少数关卡带限制，比如计算量不能超过某个数，或者最多用几个节点。限制写在评分下面，不满足时测试全过也不算通关。
body.en: A few levels set a limit, such as a maximum cost or a maximum number of parts. The limit is shown under the score, and until it is met, passing every test does not complete the level.

body.zh: 电路里传的都是一格格数字，但可以换着画法看。一个数画成读数，一行数画成波形；二维的图一开始画成像素，往后的关卡会陆续带来剖面、地形、频谱和坡度四种画法。
body.en: Everything in a circuit is a grid of numbers, but you can draw it in different ways. A single number is drawn as a reading and a single row as a waveform; a 2-D image starts out drawn as pixels, and later levels bring in four more ways: profile, terrain, spectrum and slope.

body.zh: 「像素」把亮度画成灰度，有负数的图以中灰为 0。「地形」把亮度当高度：模糊把山削圆，边缘是悬崖。「坡度」画等高线和指向变亮最快方向的箭头。「剖面」画图上一行的亮度曲线，在图上拖动换一行。<part-ref to="spectrum"></part-ref>画各频率的波有多强，中心是频率 (0, 0)。
body.en: “Pixels” draws brightness as grey; an image with negative values puts 0 at mid-grey. “Terrain” treats brightness as height: blurring rounds off the hills and edges are cliffs. “Slope” draws contour lines and arrows pointing where the image brightens fastest. “Profile” draws the brightness along one row as a curve; drag on the picture to change row. <part-ref to="spectrum"></part-ref> shows how strong the wave at each frequency is, with frequency (0, 0) at the centre.

body.zh: 每个元件可以单独换画法；电脑上画布左下角的「全部画成」一次换掉所有图像元件，旁边的按钮恢复这一关的默认画法。换画法不改电路，也不用重新测试。
body.en: Each part can switch its own view; on a desktop, “Draw all as” at the bottom left of the board switches every image part at once, and the button beside it restores the level’s default views. Changing the view does not change the circuit and needs no new test run.

body.zh: 有了可学习的元件，电路里有些权重就不再由你来填，而由机器自己调。只要电路里有这种元件，就会出现「训练 1 步」和「训练 10 步」两个按钮。
body.en: With learnable parts, some weights in a circuit are no longer filled in by you but tuned by the machine. Whenever a circuit contains such a part, two buttons appear: “Train 1 step” and “Train 10 steps”.

body.zh: 每训练一步，所有可学习的权重都朝着让误差变小的方向挪一点。旁边的损失曲线画出误差怎样变化，用的是对数刻度。
body.en: Each training step nudges every learnable weight a little in the direction that makes the error smaller. The loss curve beside the buttons shows how the error changes, on a log scale.

body.zh: 训练只看得见公开的测试，隐藏测试正好用来检查学到的东西对新图是否也成立。清空电路后，权重和损失曲线都从头开始。
body.en: Training only sees the visible tests, so the hidden tests check whether what it learned also holds for new pictures. Clearing the circuit starts the weights and the loss curve afresh.

body.zh: 有的关列出几组「新样本」：它们不参加训练，只用来检查，面板里会多画一条它们的误差线。有的关让你自己选学习率：每一步迈多大。
body.en: Some levels list a few "new samples": they take no part in training and are only checked, and the panel draws an extra error line for them. Some levels let you choose the learning rate yourself: how big each step is.

body.zh: 在计算机里，一张图像是一张数字表：画面切成许多小方格，叫像素，每格记一个亮度。这个游戏里 0 是黑，1 是白，中间是深浅不同的灰。
body.en: Inside a computer, an image is a table of numbers: the picture is cut into many small squares called pixels, and each records a brightness. In this game 0 is black, 1 is white, and the values in between are shades of grey.

body.zh: 计算机视觉的每个方法，说到底都是对这些数做运算。
body.en: Every method in computer vision comes down to arithmetic on these numbers.

body.zh: 输出的每一格只由输入里同一位置的那一格算出来，各算各的，这叫逐像素运算。乘一个系数让整张图按比例变亮或变暗，加一个常数让每格一起升高或降低，两张图也可以逐格相加、相减、相乘。
body.en: When each output cell is worked out only from the input cell in the same position, each on its own, it is a per-pixel operation. Multiplying by a factor brightens or darkens the whole image in proportion, adding a constant raises or lowers every cell together, and two images can be added, subtracted or multiplied cell by cell.

body.zh: 逐像素运算能改变亮度，却永远不知道邻居是谁。
body.en: A per-pixel operation can change brightness, but it never knows who its neighbours are.

body.zh: 把深浅不一的灰变成「是」或「否」：大于门槛的格子变 1，其余变 0。只有 0 和 1 的图叫掩膜，用来标出图中的某块区域。
body.en: A turns shades of grey into “yes” or “no”: cells above it become 1 and the rest 0. An image of only 0s and 1s is called a mask, and it marks out a region of the picture.

body.zh: 固定的摄像头要找闯进画面的东西，与其看哪里亮，不如和一张没人时拍的参照图比：差别大的地方就是新来的。这叫背景减除，它绕开了「东西本来有多亮」这个未知数。
body.en: For a fixed camera looking for whatever comes into view, comparing with a reference shot of the empty scene works far better than looking for bright spots: wherever the difference is large is new. This is background subtraction, and it sidesteps the unknown of how bright things were to begin with.

body.zh: 阈值是最简单的决策，也最脆弱：结果全看门槛定在哪，光照一变，固定的门槛常常失灵。
body.en: A threshold is the simplest kind of decision, and the most fragile: the result depends entirely on where the threshold sits, and a fixed threshold often fails once the lighting changes.

title.en: The pinhole camera and perspective projection

body.zh: 暗箱壁上开一个小孔，景物发出的光只能穿过这一点，在对面的屏上成一个倒立的像。这就是针孔相机，相机最早的样子。
body.en: Make a small hole in the wall of a dark box, and light from the scene can only pass through that one point, forming an upside-down image on the screen opposite. This is the pinhole camera, the earliest form of the camera.

body.zh: 像的大小只看比例：x = −f·X/Z，X 是物体的高度，Z 是物体到孔的距离，f 是孔到屏的距离，负号表示像是倒的。东西离得越远，像越小，这就是透视投影。
body.en: The size of the image depends only on a ratio: x = −f·X/Z, where X is the object’s height, Z its distance from the hole and f the distance from the hole to the screen; the minus sign means the image is upside down. The further away something is, the smaller its image: this is perspective projection.

body.zh: 孔开大，像更亮，可同一点的光会在屏上铺成一个斑，像也更糊。镜头就是为了打破这个两难：开大孔收进更多光，再把光重新聚回一点。
body.en: A bigger hole makes the image brighter, but light from one point spreads into a spot on the screen, so the image also gets blurrier. A lens exists to break this trade-off: open a big hole to let in more light, then bring the light back together to a point.

body.zh: 算一格输出时，不只看输入里同一位置的那一格，而是取它和周围邻居的加权和，这就是滤波。权重全是正数、加起来为 1，就是某种平均，图会变模糊。
body.en: When an output cell is computed not just from the input cell in the same place but as a weighted sum of it and its neighbours, that is filtering. If the weights are all positive and add up to 1, it is a kind of average and the image gets blurrier.

body.zh: 平均会把孤零零的亮点摊开，把忽亮忽暗的毛刺抹平。同一组权重在每个位置都一样用，图案挪到哪里，结果就跟着挪到哪里。
body.en: Averaging spreads a lone bright dot out and smooths away flickering specks. The same weights are used at every position, so wherever a pattern moves, its result moves with it.

body.zh: 有些核能拆成「一列乘一行」，比如 3×3 平均就是横向三点平均再接纵向三点平均。这时先横着滤一遍、再竖着滤一遍，结果和直接用整个核一样。这叫可分离滤波。
body.en: Some kernels split into “a column times a row”: a 3×3 average, for example, is a 3-point horizontal average followed by a 3-point vertical one. Then filtering across once and down once gives the same result as using the whole kernel. This is separable filtering.

body.zh: 好处在计算量：k×k 的核直接算要 k² 次乘加，拆开只要 2k 次。3×3 时是 9 次变 6 次，核越大省得越多。高斯核也能这样拆。
body.en: The gain is in cost: a k×k kernel takes k² multiply-adds done directly, but only 2k when split. For 3×3 that is 9 down to 6, and the bigger the kernel, the more you save. Gaussian kernels split this way too.

body.zh: 方块模糊把一个亮点摊成一块平顶的方墩，有硬边也有角。<part-ref to="gauss"></part-ref>的权重在中心最大、越远越小，切开看像一口钟，一个亮点会被摊成一座圆滑的小山。
body.en: A box blur spreads a bright dot into a flat-topped square block, with hard edges and corners. A <part-ref to="gauss"></part-ref> weights the centre most and further cells less, like a bell in cross-section, so a bright dot is spread into a smooth little hill.

body.zh: σ 决定钟有多宽：σ 越大，图越糊。平滑叠平滑会越来越像高斯，方块模糊连做三次几乎就是一个高斯，这也是高斯在视觉里随处可见的原因之一。
body.en: σ sets how wide the bell is: the larger σ, the blurrier the image. Smoothing on top of smoothing looks more and more like a Gaussian, and three box blurs in a row are almost one; that is one reason Gaussians are everywhere in vision.

body.zh: 边缘是亮度在很短距离内突然变化的地方：物体和背景的分界、文字的笔画。最简单的量法是相邻像素的差，平坦处差为 0，台阶处差最大。
body.en: An edge is where the brightness changes suddenly over a short distance: where an object meets the background, the strokes of letters. The simplest way to measure it is the difference between neighbouring pixels: 0 on flat ground, largest at a step.

body.zh: 相邻差就是离散的导数。它有正负：从暗到亮为正，从亮到暗为负，符号说明边朝哪边。结果里有负数，用地形画法看最清楚：边上是一道山脊或一条沟。
body.en: The neighbour difference is a discrete derivative. It has a sign: positive from dark to bright, negative from bright to dark, so the sign tells you which way the edge faces. Since the result can be negative, terrain view shows it best: an edge becomes a ridge or a trench.

body.zh: 平均、差分这些运算其实是同一种：每格输出是它周围一小块的加权和。把权重排成一个小方阵，就是核。换一组权重，就换一种效果。
body.en: Averaging and differencing are really the same operation: each output cell is a weighted sum of the small block around it. Lay the weights out in a small square and you have a kernel. Change the weights and you change the effect.

body.zh: 把核压过整张图，每到一处算一次加权和，就得到滤波的结果。只有正中间是 1 的核原样输出；修图软件里的很多滤镜，背后常常就是一个核。
body.en: Pass the kernel over the whole image, computing a weighted sum at each spot, and you have the filtered result. A kernel with just a 1 in the centre leaves the image unchanged; behind many photo-editor filters there is often just a kernel.

body.zh: 真实照片都带着噪声：光线暗时，每格的数会随机偏高或偏低一点。相邻差对这些小抖动非常敏感，平坦处也会冒出许多假边。
body.en: Real photos always carry noise: in dim light, each cell’s number comes out randomly a little too high or too low. Neighbour differences are very sensitive to this jitter, so false edges pop up even on flat ground.

body.zh: 办法是先平滑、再求导：噪声被压下去，真正的边留下来。Sobel 算子把这两步做进一个 3×3 核：一个方向求导，另一个方向按 1、2、1 平滑。
body.en: The fix is to smooth first and then differentiate: the noise is pushed down and the real edge stays. The Sobel operator puts both steps into one 3×3 kernel: it differentiates in one direction and smooths with weights 1, 2, 1 in the other.

body.zh: Sobel x 量左右方向的变化，Sobel y 量上下方向的变化。
body.en: Sobel x measures change from left to right and Sobel y from top to bottom.

title.zh: 卷积、互相关与冲激响应
title.en: Convolution, cross-correlation and the impulse response

body.zh: 把只有一个亮点的图交给一个核，输出就是核自己的样子，这叫冲激响应。所以看一个亮点被处理成什么样，就能读出用了什么核。
body.en: Give a kernel an image with a single bright dot and the output is the kernel itself: this is the impulse response. So seeing what a bright dot turns into tells you which kernel was used.

body.zh: 不过核有两种读法。互相关把核直接盖在图上，对应位置相乘再相加；卷积先把核旋转 180° 再盖上去。亮点经过卷积，得到正着的核；经过互相关，得到转了 180° 的核。
body.en: But there are two ways to read a kernel. Cross-correlation lays the kernel straight over the image, multiplying matching positions and adding; convolution first rotates the kernel by 180°. A bright dot put through a convolution comes out as the kernel the right way up; through a cross-correlation, as the kernel turned by 180°.

body.zh: 这个游戏里的核元件做的都是互相关。对称的核转 180° 不变，两种读法就没有区别。
body.en: The kernel parts in this game all do cross-correlation. A symmetric kernel is unchanged by a 180° turn, so for it the two readings are the same.

body.zh: 处理最边上的像素时，有的邻居落在图外。图外没有数据，只能自己补上一些值，补什么直接决定了边上一圈的结果。
body.en: When processing the pixels at the very edge, some neighbours fall outside the image. There is no data out there, so values have to be filled in, and what is filled in directly decides the result all round the border.

body.zh: 补 0 等于在图外画了一圈黑框：在亮背景上做平均，边上会多出一圈暗边，求导时还会在图边造出假边缘。复制边缘把图外缺的值当作离它最近的边上像素，不会凭空造出边界。
body.en: Padding with 0 amounts to drawing a black frame round the image: averaging on a bright background leaves a dark ring round the border, and differentiating creates a false edge there. Replicate edge treats each missing value as the nearest pixel on the edge, so no border appears out of nowhere.

body.zh: 在这个游戏里，平移和各个滤波元件的「边界」设置都可以在「补 0」和「复制边缘」之间选。
body.en: In this game, the “Border” setting of Shift and of every filter can choose between “Pad with 0” and “Replicate edge”.

body.zh: 原图减去模糊图，剩下的是模糊抹掉的那部分：边缘、细纹这些变化很快的东西，也就是细节。
body.en: The original minus a blurred copy leaves exactly what the blur wiped out: edges, fine texture and other things that change quickly. That is the detail.

body.zh: 把细节按一定比例加回原图，边缘两侧的明暗差被拉大，图就显得更锐利，这就是锐化。修图软件里的 USM 锐化（unsharp mask）就是这个做法，源自暗房时代把模糊底片和原底片叠印的技巧。
body.en: Add the detail back to the original in some proportion and the contrast on either side of each edge is stretched, so the image looks sharper: this is sharpening. The USM (unsharp mask) sharpening in photo editors works this way, and comes from a darkroom trick of printing a blurred negative together with the original.

body.zh: 加得太多，边缘旁会出现一道明显的亮边和暗边。锐化并不能找回丢失的信息，只是让已有的变化更显眼。
body.en: Add too much and an obvious bright and dark halo appears beside each edge. Sharpening cannot recover lost information; it only makes the changes already there stand out.

body.zh: 熟练以后，扫一眼核里的数就能猜出它做什么。全是正数、加起来为 1 的核在平滑，权重越集中在中心，结果越接近原图。
body.en: With practice, a glance at the numbers in a kernel tells you what it does. All positive and adding up to 1 means smoothing, and the more the weight is concentrated in the centre, the closer the result is to the original.

body.zh: 加起来为 0 的核在平坦处输出 0，只对变化有反应，是在求导。中心大、四周为负的是锐化。只有一个 1 的核是平移：按互相关的读法，图挪动的方向和 1 偏离中心的方向相反。
body.en: A kernel that adds up to 0 gives 0 on flat ground and responds only to change: it is a derivative. A large centre with negative surroundings is sharpening. A kernel with a single 1 is a shift: read as cross-correlation, the image moves the opposite way from where the 1 sits off-centre.

title.zh: 波：振幅、频率、相位与方向
title.en: Waves: amplitude, frequency, phase and direction

body.zh: 一道波是明暗规律起伏的条纹。一行上的波只要四个数：平均亮度 c、振幅 A（明暗差多大）、频率 k（整幅宽度里走几个周期）和相位 φ（整体往哪边挪）。
body.en: A wave is a stripe pattern whose brightness rises and falls regularly. A wave along a row takes just four numbers: the average brightness c, the amplitude A (how far light and dark differ), the frequency k (how many cycles across the whole width) and the phase φ (how far the whole wave is slid along).

body.zh: 图像里的波还有方向：横着走 kx 个周期、竖着走 ky 个周期。条纹总是和箭头 (kx, ky) 垂直，箭头越长，条纹越密。
body.en: A wave in an image also has a direction: kx cycles across and ky cycles down. The stripes always run perpendicular to the arrow (kx, ky), and the longer the arrow, the denser the stripes.

body.zh: 最光滑的波是正弦波（cos 或 sin）。再复杂的图案，也是许多这样的波叠起来的。
body.en: The smoothest waves are sinusoids (cos or sin). Any pattern, however complex, is many such waves added together.

body.zh: 任何一条亮度曲线都能拆成一组正弦波：每个频率一个振幅，再加一个相位。这组振幅，就是这条曲线的<part-ref to="spectrum"></part-ref>。
body.en: Any brightness curve can be taken apart into a set of sine waves: one amplitude for each frequency, plus a phase. That set of amplitudes is the curve’s <part-ref to="spectrum"></part-ref>.

body.zh: 边越陡，需要的高频越多。方波只用到奇数频率，振幅按 1、1/3、1/5、1/7 递减；少了高频，陡边旁就会冒出一圈小波纹。
body.en: The steeper an edge, the more high frequencies it needs. A square wave uses only odd frequencies, with amplitudes falling as 1, 1/3, 1/5, 1/7; leave out the high ones and small ripples appear beside the steep edges.

body.zh: 模糊过的曲线只剩低频。从这个角度看，模糊就是把高频调小。
body.en: A blurred curve keeps only its low frequencies. Seen this way, blurring means turning the high frequencies down.

body.zh: 拿到一条叠好的曲线，怎样知道某个频率的波有多强？把信号和这个频率的 cos、sin 逐点相乘再求平均，得到两个读数 a、b。别的频率的波相乘后平均下来是 0，只有同频率的留得下来。
body.en: Given a curve that is already added up, how do you tell how strong the wave at one frequency is? Multiply the signal point by point by the cos and the sin of that frequency and take the averages, giving two readings a and b. Waves at other frequencies average out to 0; only the one at that frequency remains.

body.zh: 振幅是 2·√(a² + b²)，和波错开多少无关；相位是 atan2(b, a)。只用 cos 的话，错开 90° 的波会被量成 0。
body.en: The amplitude is 2·√(a² + b²), however far the wave is shifted, and the phase is atan2(b, a). With cos alone, a wave shifted by 90° would measure as 0.

body.zh: 对每个频率都这样量一遍，就是傅里叶变换。它把一张图从「每个位置多亮」换成「每个频率的波有多强」，再变换回来也一点信息都不丢。
body.en: Measuring every frequency this way is the Fourier transform. It turns an image from “how bright each position is” into “how strong the wave at each frequency is”, and transforming back loses nothing.

body.zh: 二维图像的频谱也是一张图：每一格 (kx, ky) 代表一道波，越亮说明图里这道波越强。正中心是频率 (0, 0)，也就是平均亮度，叫直流分量。
body.en: The spectrum of a 2-D image is itself an image: each cell (kx, ky) stands for one wave, and the brighter it is, the stronger that wave is in the picture. The very centre is frequency (0, 0), the average brightness, called the DC component.

body.zh: 离中心越远，代表变化越快：条纹越密，亮点离中心越远；条纹转 90°，亮点也跟着转 90°，总是排在和条纹垂直的方向上。一组条纹在频谱上是关于中心对称的一对亮点。
body.en: Further from the centre means faster change: the denser the stripes, the further their dots sit from the centre. Turn the stripes by 90° and the dots turn by 90° too, always lined up perpendicular to the stripes. One set of stripes shows up as a pair of dots placed symmetrically about the centre.

body.zh: 模糊的图只剩中心一团低频，噪声则什么频率都有。游戏里的频谱按对数画，弱的波也看得见。
body.en: A blurred image keeps only a clump of low frequencies in the centre, while noise has every frequency. The game draws spectra on a log scale, so weak waves show up too.

body.zh: 在空间里用一个核做卷积，等于在频域里把每个频率乘上一个增益，这个增益就是核的频谱。这叫卷积定理：空间里卷积，等于频域里相乘。
body.en: Convolving with a kernel in space is the same as multiplying each frequency by a gain in the frequency domain, where the gain is the kernel’s spectrum. This is the convolution theorem: convolution in space is multiplication in frequency.

body.zh: 一刀切的增益（某个频率以下全留、以上全去）变回空间，是一个两侧带负瓣的核，边缘两侧会冒出一圈圈亮暗波纹，这叫振铃。高斯形状的增益变回空间还是高斯，没有负瓣，也就没有振铃。
body.en: A hard cut-off gain (keep everything below some frequency, remove everything above) turns back into a kernel with negative lobes on both sides, so rings of light and dark ripple out beside edges: this is ringing. A Gaussian-shaped gain turns back into a Gaussian, with no negative lobes and so no ringing.

body.zh: 高斯越宽，它的频谱越窄：空间里模糊得越厉害，频域里留下的频率越少。
body.en: The wider a Gaussian, the narrower its spectrum: the more it blurs in space, the fewer frequencies it keeps.

body.zh: 留下低频、去掉高频的滤波叫低通。低频是大块缓慢的明暗，高频是细纹、边缘和噪点，所以低通的效果就是模糊和去噪。
body.en: A filter that keeps the low frequencies and removes the high ones is called a low-pass filter. Low frequencies are broad, slow changes in brightness and high ones are fine texture, edges and noise, so a low-pass filter blurs and removes noise.

body.zh: 它可以在空间里用模糊核做，也可以在频域里做：变换到频谱，乘一个以中心为圆心的掩膜，再变换回来。掩膜的半径决定留下多少频率，半径越小，图越糊。
body.en: It can be done in space with a blur kernel, or in the frequency domain: transform to the spectrum, multiply by a mask centred on the middle, and transform back. The mask’s radius decides how many frequencies are kept: the smaller the radius, the blurrier the image.

body.zh: 相机和扫描仪只在一些位置记下亮度，用这些点代表连续的景物，这叫采样。采 M 个点，只能分辨 M/2 以下的频率，这个上限叫奈奎斯特频率。
body.en: A camera or scanner records brightness only at certain positions and lets those points stand for the continuous scene: this is sampling. With M samples you can only tell apart frequencies below M/2, a limit called the Nyquist frequency.

body.zh: 更快的波不会消失，而是折回来冒充一道慢波：频率 k 看起来和 M − k 一模一样。这叫混叠，采完以后两者再也分不开。视频里飞转的车轮像在倒转、拍屏幕时浮出的波纹（莫尔纹），都是混叠。
body.en: Faster waves do not vanish: they fold back and pose as a slower wave, so frequency k looks exactly like M − k. This is aliasing, and once sampled the two can never be separated. A spinning wheel that seems to turn backwards on video, and the ripples (moiré) that float over a photo of a screen, are both aliasing.

body.zh: 所以抗混叠必须在采样之前：先低通去掉高于奈奎斯特频率的部分，再采样。拍照、扫描都会碰到同一个问题。
body.en: So anti-aliasing has to happen before sampling: low-pass away everything above the Nyquist frequency first, then sample. Taking photos and scanning both face the same problem.

body.zh: 高通只留下细节：高通 = 原图 − 低通，在频域里就是把掩膜 H 换成 1 − H。
body.en: A high-pass filter keeps only the detail: high-pass = image − low-pass, which in the frequency domain means replacing the mask H with 1 − H.

body.zh: 一张图的大块明暗取自 A（低频），细节取自 B（高频），就是混合图像。近看时细节最抢眼，看到的是 B；离远了或眯起眼，细节分辨不出来，只剩下 A。
body.en: Take an image’s broad light and dark from A (its low frequencies) and its detail from B (its high frequencies), and you have a hybrid image. Up close the detail stands out and you see B; from a distance, or with narrowed eyes, the detail can no longer be made out and only A is left.

body.zh: 滤波是线性的：先合起来再滤，和分别滤完再合起来，结果一样。这让很多看起来要两步的事可以合成一步。
body.en: Filtering is linear: combining and then filtering gives the same result as filtering each and then combining. That lets many things that seem to need two steps be done in one.

body.zh: 表面会弹回多少光，叫反射率：白漆接近 1，黑漆接近 0。表面「正前方」的方向叫法线，可以想成从表面正中竖起的一根小杆。
body.en: How much light a surface sends back is its reflectance: close to 1 for white paint, close to 0 for black. The direction a surface faces “straight out” is its normal, which you can picture as a small stick standing up from the middle of the surface.

body.zh: 哑光表面大致遵守朗伯模型：亮度 = 灯的强度 × 反射率 × cos θ，θ 是光线和法线的夹角。光斜着照时，同一束光铺到更大的面积上，所以变暗；cos 60° = 0.5，斜 60° 时亮度减半。
body.en: Matte surfaces roughly follow the Lambertian model: brightness = lamp strength × reflectance × cos θ, where θ is the angle between the light and the normal. Light arriving at a slant spreads the same beam over a larger area, so it is dimmer; cos 60° = 0.5, so at 60° the brightness is halved.

body.zh: 照片只留下这三者的乘积：一块地方暗，可能是灯弱了、漆暗了，也可能只是表面转开了。单看亮度，分不出是哪一个。
body.en: A photo keeps only the product of the three: a dark patch may mean a weaker lamp, darker paint, or just a surface turned away. From brightness alone you cannot tell which.

body.zh: 现实里的光是一整条光谱：每种波长各有多少。相机和人眼一样只有三种感光元件，各对一段波长敏感，于是整条光谱被压成三个数：R、G、B。
body.en: Real light is a whole spectrum: so much of each wavelength. Cameras, like eyes, have only three kinds of light sensor, each sensitive to a band of wavelengths, so the whole spectrum is squeezed into three numbers: R, G and B.

body.zh: 压缩会丢东西：许多完全不同的光谱会得到同样的 R、G、B，这叫同色异谱。屏幕就靠这一点，用红光加绿光让你看到黄色。可是换一盏灯，物体反射的光谱跟着变，两块在日光下一样的布就可能不一样了。
body.en: Squeezing loses something: many completely different spectra give the same R, G and B. This is called metamerism. Screens rely on it, using red light plus green light to make you see yellow. But change the lamp and the spectrum an object reflects changes too, so two cloths that match in daylight may stop matching.

body.zh: RGB、HSV、Lab 只是给这三个数换不同的坐标。比如 Lab 把明暗和颜色分开，想改颜色又不改明暗时就很方便。
body.en: RGB, HSV and Lab just give these three numbers different coordinates. Lab, for example, separates lightness from colour, which is handy when you want to change a colour without changing its lightness.

body.zh: 反过来问：只看到一个亮度，能不能推出表面朝哪？一个亮度只说明法线和灯之间的夹角，满足这个夹角的朝向有一整圈，所以单张照片恢复不出唯一的朝向。
body.en: Now the other way round: from one brightness, can you work out which way a surface faces? A brightness only tells you the angle between the normal and the lamp, and a whole ring of facings has that angle, so a single photo cannot recover a unique facing.

body.zh: 从明暗恢复形状（shape from shading）必须靠额外的假设：颜色均匀、灯已知、表面平滑。人看照片时，也在悄悄做这些假设。
body.en: Shape from shading has to rely on extra assumptions: an even colour, a known lamp, a smooth surface. People quietly make the same assumptions when they look at a photo.

body.zh: 换一盏灯再拍一张，两圈候选的朝向只在一两处相交；用三盏灯，连反射率也能一起解出来，这叫光度立体。
body.en: Change the lamp and take another photo, and the two rings of possible facings cross at only one or two points; with three lamps you can solve for the reflectance as well. This is called photometric stereo.

body.zh: 照片里，表面本来的颜色和照到的光乘在一起：照片 = 颜色 × 光照。白墙在阴影里是灰的，深色地砖在太阳底下也可能很亮。
body.en: In a photo, a surface’s own colour and the light falling on it are multiplied together: photo = colour × lighting. A white wall in shadow looks grey, and dark floor tiles can look bright in sunshine.

body.zh: 所以照片里的边缘只说明「这里亮度变了」，变的可能是颜色，也可能只是光：一面纯色墙上的影子，也有一条很硬的边。把照片拆成颜色和光照两部分，叫本征图像分解。
body.en: So an edge in a photo only says “the brightness changes here”; what changed may be the colour, or just the light. A shadow on a plain wall has a hard edge too. Splitting a photo into its colour and its lighting is called intrinsic image decomposition.

body.zh: 真实相机不会附送光照图，单看亮度也猜不准光照。
body.en: A real camera does not come with a lighting map, and brightness alone cannot pin the lighting down.

body.zh: 梯度是一个箭头 (gx, gy)：gx 是往右每走一格亮度变多少，gy 是往下。把图想成地形，箭头总指向上坡最陡的方向，也就是变亮最快的方向。
body.en: The gradient is an arrow (gx, gy): gx is how much the brightness changes for each step to the right, and gy the same going down. Think of the image as a landscape, and the arrow always points straight up the steepest slope, the way the brightness rises fastest.

body.zh: 箭头的长度 √(gx² + gy²) 说明有多陡，方向是 atan2(gy, gx)。在边上，箭头又长又垂直于边：边缘就是梯度很大的地方。
body.en: The arrow’s length √(gx² + gy²) says how steep it is, and its direction is atan2(gy, gx). On an edge the arrow is long and perpendicular to the edge: an edge is where the gradient is large.

body.zh: 在每个像素都算出箭头长度，画成一张越陡越亮的图，就是边缘强度图。它和边朝哪个方向无关：横边、竖边、斜边一样亮。再定一个门槛，超过的像素才算边。
body.en: Work out the arrow’s length at every pixel and draw it as an image, brighter where steeper, and you have an edge strength map. It does not depend on which way an edge runs: horizontal, vertical and diagonal edges are equally bright. Set a threshold on it, and the pixels above it count as edges.

body.zh: 同一个场景换了灯，像素数值会差很远，该给的答案却一样。设计特征时先问：哪些变化不应该改变答案？让答案不随这些变化而变，叫不变性。
body.en: Light the same scene differently and the pixel values can differ a lot, yet the right answer stays the same. When designing a feature, first ask: which changes should not change the answer? Making the answer immune to those changes is called invariance.

body.zh: 灯光变化大致有两种。整体加亮（每个像素 + b，偏置）只把地形整体抬高，坡度不变，所以梯度对它不变；灯变强或变暗（每个像素 × a，增益）把所有坡度都乘上 a，固定的门槛就会失灵。
body.en: Lighting changes come roughly in two kinds. Brightening everything (+ b on every pixel, an offset) just lifts the whole landscape and leaves the slopes as they were, so the gradient is unchanged by it. A stronger or dimmer lamp (× a on every pixel, a gain) multiplies every slope by a, so a fixed threshold stops working.

body.zh: 要让机器自己调参数，先得有一个分数说明「现在调得有多差」。这个分数叫损失（误差）：模型的输出离正确答案有多远，常用的是差的平方再取平均。
body.en: Before a machine can tune its own parameters, it needs a score for “how bad is it now”. That score is the loss (the error): how far the model’s output is from the right answer, commonly the average of the squared differences.

body.zh: 把所有可调的数看成位置、损失看成地形，训练就是下山。梯度指向上坡最陡的方向，每一步往反方向走「学习率 × 梯度」，这叫梯度下降。
body.en: Treat all the adjustable numbers as a position and the loss as a landscape, and training is walking downhill. The gradient points up the steepest slope, and each step moves “learning rate × gradient” the opposite way: this is gradient descent.

body.zh: 学习率太小要走很多步，太大会在山谷两边来回冲、越冲越远。山谷又窄又长时，梯度总指向谷壁，路线会走成之字形。一个网络有上百万个旋钮，原理完全一样。
body.en: Too small a learning rate takes many steps; too large and you bounce from one side of the valley to the other, further each time. In a long, narrow valley the gradient keeps pointing at the walls, so the path zig-zags. A network has millions of knobs, and the principle is exactly the same.

body.zh: 一个神经元先算加权和 w1·x1 + w2·x2 + b，再用 Sigmoid 把结果压到 0 和 1 之间，读作「有多大把握」。w1·x1 + w2·x2 + b = 0 是平面上的一条直线，所以一个神经元就是一条分界线；权重越大，判断越果断。
body.en: A neuron first computes a weighted sum w1·x1 + w2·x2 + b, then uses a sigmoid to squash the result between 0 and 1, read as “how sure”. w1·x1 + w2·x2 + b = 0 is a straight line in the plane, so one neuron is one dividing line; the larger the weights, the more decisive the judgement.

body.zh: 可是「异或」这样的问题，一条直线怎么摆都分不开。而且只用加、减和乘常数，叠多少层都还是线性的：两层线性叠起来，仍然只是一条直线。
body.en: But for a problem like XOR, no single straight line can separate the points, however it is placed. And with only adding, subtracting and multiplying by constants, any number of layers stays linear: two linear layers stacked are still just one straight line.

body.zh: 层与层之间插一个非线性的激活函数，网络才能画出弯曲的分界。最常用的是 ReLU：负数变 0，正数原样通过，写作 max(0, x)。
body.en: Put a nonlinear activation function between the layers, and the network can draw curved boundaries. The most common is ReLU: negatives become 0 and positives pass unchanged, written max(0, x).

title.zh: 卷积层：步幅、补边与参数量
title.en: Convolution layers: stride, padding and parameters

body.zh: 卷积层的窗口就是一个核，在图上一处处停下来算一个数。输出边长 = ⌊(N + 2p − k) / s⌋ + 1：N 是输入边长，k 是窗口大小，p 是补边宽度，s 是步幅，也就是每次挪几格。步幅大于 1 时跳着停，图随之缩小。
body.en: A convolution layer’s window is a kernel that stops at one place after another, computing one number at each. Output side = ⌊(N + 2p − k) / s⌋ + 1, where N is the input side, k the window size, p the padding width and s the stride, how many cells it moves each time. With a stride above 1 it skips stops and the image shrinks.

body.zh: 参数只和窗口有关：每个滤波器有 k × k × 通道数 个权重，再加 1 个偏置，不管图有多大。同一组权重到处用，叫权重共享，它省下了大量参数，也让同一个图案出现在哪里都认得出来。
body.en: The parameters depend only on the window: each filter has k × k × channels weights plus 1 bias, however big the image is. Using the same weights everywhere is called weight sharing; it saves a huge number of parameters, and lets a pattern be recognised wherever it appears.

body.zh: 要是把每个输出像素都连到每个输入像素（全连接），参数会多得多，而且图一变大就跟着暴涨。
body.en: If every output pixel were connected to every input pixel (fully connected), there would be far more parameters, and they would balloon as the image grows.

body.zh: 最大池化把图切成 2×2 的小块，每块只留最大值，尺寸减半。它只问「这一块里最强的是多少」，不问最强的在块里哪个位置。
body.en: Max pooling cuts the image into 2×2 blocks and keeps only the largest value of each, halving the size. It asks only “what is the strongest value in this block”, not where in the block it is.

body.zh: 所以一个点只要还在同一块里挪动，结果就不变，网络因此能容忍一点点平移。代价是丢掉了块内的精确位置。
body.en: So as long as a point moves within the same block, the result does not change, which lets a network tolerate small shifts. The price is losing the exact position inside the block.

body.zh: 一个输出像素能「看到」的输入范围，叫感受野。一层 3×3 只看到 3×3，可第二层看的是第一层的输出，等于看到了 5×5；叠 L 层 3×3，感受野是 (2L+1)×(2L+1)。
body.en: The patch of input that one output pixel can “see” is its receptive field. One 3×3 layer sees 3×3, but the second layer looks at the first layer’s output, so in effect it sees 5×5; stack L layers of 3×3 and the receptive field is (2L+1)×(2L+1).

body.zh: 用小核堆出大范围还更省：三层 3×3 只有 27 个权重，一个 7×7 核要 49 个，层间还能插入非线性。VGG 这类网络就是这样搭的；池化和大步幅会让感受野长得更快。
body.en: Stacking small kernels to see a large area is also cheaper: three 3×3 layers have only 27 weights, while one 7×7 kernel needs 49, and nonlinearities can go in between. Networks like VGG are built this way; pooling and larger strides make the receptive field grow faster still.

body.zh: 彩色图是三张图叠在一起：红、绿、蓝各一张，叫三个通道。卷积网络每一层的输出也往往有很多通道，每个滤波器出一张。
body.en: A colour image is three images stacked together, one each for red, green and blue, called three channels. Each layer of a convolutional network usually outputs many channels too, one per filter.

body.zh: 一个卷积核要同时覆盖所有输入通道：3 个通道的 3×3 核有 3×3×3 = 27 个权重，三份乘积加成一张输出。不同通道的权重可以一正一负，这样同时变亮的部分互相抵消，只剩颜色的对比。
body.en: A convolution kernel has to cover all the input channels at once: a 3×3 kernel over 3 channels has 3×3×3 = 27 weights, and the three sets of products add up to one output. The weights for different channels can have opposite signs, so whatever brightens in every channel cancels out and only the colour contrast is left.

body.zh: 训练好的卷积网络第一层里，常能看到这种对颜色对比敏感的滤波器：红对绿、蓝对黄，和人眼视网膜里的两组颜色对立一样。
body.en: In the first layer of a trained convolutional network you often find such filters tuned to colour contrast: red against green and blue against yellow, the same two colour oppositions as in the human retina.

body.zh: 卷积神经网络（CNN）把这些部件串起来：卷积找局部的笔画和纹理，ReLU 把「有」和「没有」分开，池化缩小图并容忍平移，最后由全连接层和 Sigmoid 把特征变成分数。回答「这是什么」的任务叫分类。
body.en: A convolutional neural network (CNN) strings these pieces together: convolutions find local strokes and textures, ReLU separates “there” from “not there”, pooling shrinks the image and tolerates shifts, and finally a dense layer and a sigmoid turn the features into a score. A task that answers “what is this?” is called classification.

body.zh: 网络里的核不是人设计的，而是从例子里学出来的：权重从很小的随机数开始，训练把它们调成有用的特征。在大多数视觉任务里，学到的特征已经取代了手工设计的特征。
body.en: The kernels in the network are not designed by anyone but learned from examples: the weights start as small random numbers and training turns them into useful features. In most vision tasks, learned features have replaced hand-designed ones.

body.zh: 要是一路全是线性运算，整个网络就只等于一次线性运算，很多简单的区分都做不到。
body.en: If every operation along the way were linear, the whole network would amount to a single linear operation, and many simple distinctions would be out of reach.

body.zh: 训练误差一直降，新样本上的误差却先降后升：后半段模型在背训练样本里的噪声，这叫过拟合。所以要留一部分数据只用来检查，叫验证集。
body.en: The training error keeps falling, but the error on new samples falls and then rises: in the second half the model is memorising the noise in its training samples. This is overfitting. That is why part of the data is kept back for checking only: the validation set.

body.zh: 办法之一是提前停止：在验证误差最低时停下。办法之二是正则化：给大权重加代价（L2），让模型不愿意为了几个点把曲线拧得很弯。
body.en: One fix is early stopping: stop where the validation error is lowest. Another is regularisation: put a cost on large weights (L2), so the model will not bend the curve sharply just to hit a few points.

body.zh: 正则化的强度 λ 太小拦不住过拟合，太大又让模型连真规律都学不会，叫欠拟合。Dropout 和数据增强也是为了同样的目的。
body.en: If the strength λ is too small it cannot hold off overfitting; too large and the model cannot learn even the true rule, which is called underfitting. Dropout and data augmentation serve the same purpose.

body.zh: 网络越深，能表达的越多，可层一多反而常常训不动。直接堆叠时，每层的梯度都要乘上其余各层的权重，乘的次数一多就接近 0，损失纹丝不动，这叫梯度消失。
body.en: A deeper network can express more, yet with many layers it often will not train. When layers are simply stacked, each layer’s gradient is multiplied by the weights of the other layers, and with enough factors it gets close to 0 and the loss does not budge. This is the vanishing gradient problem.

body.zh: 残差连接把每一块的输入直接加到它的输出上：y = F(x) + x。每块一开始就是「原样通过」，只需学和原样的差 F(x)，梯度也能沿着捷径直达每一层。ResNet 就靠它把网络堆到上百层。
body.en: A residual connection adds each block’s input straight to its output: y = F(x) + x. Every block starts out “passing its input straight through” and only has to learn the difference F(x), and the gradient reaches every layer directly along the shortcut. This is how ResNet stacks networks to more than a hundred layers.

body.zh: 卷积只看身边一小圈，线索在图的另一头时，要叠很多层才够得着。自注意力让每个位置一步就和所有位置比较：把图切成小块，每块叫一个 token，按「像不像」给所有图块打分，再按分数取加权平均。
body.en: A convolution only looks at a small ring around itself, so when the clue is at the far side of the image it takes many layers to reach it. Self-attention lets every position compare itself with every other in one step: the image is cut into patches, each called a token, and each scores every patch by how alike they are, then takes an average weighted by those scores.

body.zh: 具体地说，每个图块有查询 q、键 k 和值 v：打分是 q·k/√d，softmax 把分数变成加起来为 1 的权重，再对所有 v 加权平均。2020 年的 ViT 就是这样处理图像的。
body.en: In detail, each patch has a query q, a key k and a value v: the score is q·k/√d, softmax turns the scores into weights that add up to 1, and the v of every patch are averaged with those weights. ViT, from 2020, handles images this way.

body.zh: 自注意力只按「像不像」分配权重，不知道每个图块排在第几。把两个图块对调，输出也只是跟着对调：它看到的是一袋图块，而不是一串。
body.en: Self-attention assigns weights only by how alike patches are; it does not know where each one sits. Swap two patches and the output just swaps with them: it sees a bag of patches, not a sequence.

body.zh: 位置编码给每个图块加上一个代表位置的量：z̃ᵢ = zᵢ + pᵢ，像给每块贴上门牌号，顺序才进得了计算。ViT 在进入第一层之前就把位置加到每个图块上。
body.en: A positional encoding adds a quantity standing for position to each patch: z̃ᵢ = zᵢ + pᵢ, like a house number on every patch, so that order can enter the computation. ViT adds the positions to every patch before the first layer.

body.zh: 绝大多数照片没有标签。一个办法是把一张图做成两个变形版本（挪一点、调亮暗、加噪声）：它们一定来自同一张图，这件事本身就能当答案。不靠人工标签、让数据自己提供答案的学法，叫自监督学习。
body.en: Most photos have no labels. One way round this is to make two altered versions of an image (shifted a little, brightened or darkened, with noise added): they certainly come from the same image, and that fact can itself serve as the answer. Learning where the data supplies its own answers, without human labels, is called self-supervised learning.

body.zh: 对比学习把同一张图的两个视图（正对）拉近，把同一批里的其他视图（负对）推开，InfoNCE 损失就是这样写的。SimCLR 是这类方法里有名的一个。
body.en: Contrastive learning pulls the two views of the same image (a positive pair) together and pushes the other views in the batch (negative pairs) apart; the InfoNCE loss is written this way. SimCLR is a well-known example.

body.zh: 只拉近、不推开的话，把所有图都放到同一点就能让损失最小，却什么也分不出来，这叫坍缩。
body.en: Pull together without pushing apart, and putting every image at the same point minimises the loss but tells nothing apart. This is called collapse.

body.zh: 要在两张照片里认出同一个点，这个点得好认。平坦处往哪挪看起来都一样；直边上，沿着边挪也看不出区别；只有在角点，往哪个方向挪都会变。
body.en: To recognise the same point in two photos, the point has to be easy to find again. On flat ground a move in any direction looks the same; on a straight edge, a move along the edge looks the same; only at a corner does a move in any direction change what you see.

body.zh: Harris 角点检测统计每个像素周围一小块里两个方向的梯度，排成一个 2×2 矩阵，用 R = det − k·trace² 打分：两个方向变化都大时 R 大而为正，是角；直边只有一个方向大，R 为负；平坦处 R 接近 0。
body.en: The Harris corner detector gathers the gradients in both directions over a small patch round each pixel into a 2×2 matrix and scores it with R = det − k·trace²: when the change is large in both directions R is large and positive, a corner; a straight edge is large in only one direction, so R is negative; on flat ground R is close to 0.

body.zh: 图转了个角度，角点还是角点，所以它常被当作拼接全景、跟踪运动时的关键点。
body.en: A corner is still a corner when the image is rotated, which is why corners are often used as key points for stitching panoramas and tracking motion.

title.zh: 特征匹配与距离比检验
title.en: Feature matching and the ratio test

body.zh: 找到关键点后要配对：拿左图一个点周围的一小块，到右图里找最像的一块。像不像用距离 d 量，越小越像；最近的叫第一名（距离 d₁），其次是第二名（d₂）。
body.en: Once key points are found they need pairing: take the small patch round a point in the left image and look for the most similar patch in the right one. Similarity is measured as a distance d, smaller meaning more alike; the closest is first place (distance d₁) and the next is second place (d₂).

body.zh: 重复的图案（比如一格格的栅栏）会让第一名和第二名几乎一样近，这种匹配再「像」也不可信，只看距离挡不住它。距离比检验 d₁ / d₂ < r 只收下第一名明显领先的匹配，常取 r = 0.8。
body.en: A repeating pattern (a fence of identical tiles, say) makes first and second place almost equally close; however “alike” such a match is, it cannot be trusted, and a distance threshold alone cannot stop it. The ratio test d₁ / d₂ < r accepts only matches whose first place is clearly ahead; r = 0.8 is a common choice.

body.zh: 边缘检测给的是一堆零散的点。Hough 变换让每个点为所有穿过它的直线投票：直线用方向 θ 和离中心的距离 ρ 两个数记下，ρ = x·cos θ + y·sin θ。真有的那条线会收到很多票。
body.en: Edge detection gives a scatter of points. The Hough transform has each point vote for every line through it: a line is recorded by two numbers, its direction θ and its distance ρ from the centre, with ρ = x·cos θ + y·sin θ. A line that is really there collects many votes.

body.zh: 票落进 (θ, ρ) 平面上的格子（分箱），这张格子图叫累加器，找线就变成了找峰。分箱太细，噪声把一条线的票拆成许多小峰；太粗，相近的两条线合成一个峰。
body.en: The votes fall into cells (bins) on the (θ, ρ) plane, a grid called the accumulator, so finding a line becomes finding a peak. With bins too fine, noise splits one line’s votes into many small peaks; too coarse, and two nearby lines merge into one peak.

body.zh: 参数一多，格子数按乘方增长：直线只有 2 个参数；要是有 8 个参数，每维 10 格就是 10⁸ 格。
body.en: With more parameters the number of cells grows as a power: a line has only 2 parameters, but with 8 parameters, 10 cells per dimension makes 10⁸ cells.

body.zh: 配对和找线时总会混进错的点，叫外点；对的叫内点。用一条线去贴合所有点，几个离得远的外点就能把它拽歪。
body.en: When matching or finding lines, wrong points always creep in: outliers; the right ones are inliers. Fit one line to all the points and a few distant outliers can drag it off course.

body.zh: RANSAC 换了个思路：随机抽出模型最少需要的几个点（直线是 2 个）算出模型，数有多少点离它够近（在 δ 以内），反复很多轮，留下支持最多的那个。
body.en: RANSAC takes another approach: draw at random the fewest points a model needs (2 for a line), work out the model, count how many points lie close enough to it (within δ), repeat for many rounds, and keep the one with the most support.

body.zh: 轮数来自概率：内点比例为 p、每轮抽 n 个点，要成功率达到 P，需要 k ≥ log(1 − P) / log(1 − pⁿ) 轮。轮数由内点比例决定，δ 由噪声决定，两者不能互相代替。
body.en: The number of rounds comes from probability: with an inlier ratio p and n points drawn per round, reaching a success rate P needs k ≥ log(1 − P) / log(1 − pⁿ) rounds. The number of rounds is set by the inlier ratio and δ by the noise; neither can stand in for the other.

body.zh: 斜着拍一本书，封面在照片里就不再方方正正。把一个平面上的点映到照片里的变换叫单应，用一个 3×3 矩阵 H 表示，有 8 个自由度。
body.en: Photograph a book at a slant and the cover is no longer a neat rectangle. The transformation that maps the points of a plane into the photo is a homography, written as a 3×3 matrix H with 8 degrees of freedom.

body.zh: 每对对应点给 2 个方程，所以至少要 4 对点，常用 DLT 解出 H。仿射变换只有 6 个自由度，3 对点就能定下，但它让平行线保持平行，贴不上透视下的书。
body.en: Each pair of corresponding points gives 2 equations, so at least 4 pairs are needed, and H is usually solved with DLT. An affine map has only 6 degrees of freedom and is fixed by 3 pairs, but it keeps parallel lines parallel, so it cannot fit a book seen in perspective.

body.zh: 实际流水线里，点对来自通过距离比检验的候选，再由 RANSAC 反复抽 4 对、数内点选出来。全景拼接和增强现实都这样做。
body.en: In a real pipeline the pairs come from candidates that passed the ratio test, and RANSAC picks them by repeatedly drawing 4 pairs and counting inliers. Panorama stitching and augmented reality both work this way.

body.zh: 同一样东西在左右两张图里错开的距离，叫视差。近的东西错得多，远的错得少，所以视差越大，物体越近。
body.en: The distance by which the same thing is offset between the left and right images is its disparity. Near things are offset more and far things less, so the larger the disparity, the nearer the object.

body.zh: 两台相机摆正时，对应点总在同一行，只需沿着这一行找：右图挪几格时和左图最像。这叫立体匹配。随机噪点图证明，人不认出任何物体也能看出立体。
body.en: When the two cameras are lined up, corresponding points are always on the same row, so the search only runs along that row: which shift of the right image matches the left one best. This is stereo matching. Random-dot images show that people can see depth without recognising any object.

body.zh: 比较时围着每格取一个窗口。大窗口抗噪，却会抹掉细节；小窗口保细节，却怕噪声。没有对所有图都最好的窗口，多尺度、全局优化等方法都在设法同时要两者。
body.en: Each comparison uses a window round the cell. A large window resists noise but wipes out detail; a small one keeps detail but is vulnerable to noise. No window is best for every image, and methods such as multi-scale and global optimisation try to get both at once.

body.zh: 把视差换成距离，靠的是和针孔相机同一个道理：深度 z = f·b / d，f 是焦距，b 是两台相机之间的距离（叫基线），d 是视差。
body.en: Converting disparity into distance uses the same reasoning as the pinhole camera: depth z = f·b / d, where f is the focal length, b the distance between the two cameras (the baseline) and d the disparity.

body.zh: 视差按像素计，差一个像素，深度就差一截：|Δz| ≈ z²/(f·b)·|Δd|，远两倍的东西误差大四倍。
body.en: Disparity is counted in pixels, and one pixel off throws the depth off noticeably: |Δz| ≈ z²/(f·b)·|Δd|, so something twice as far has four times the error.

body.zh: 加宽基线或换长焦能让远处更准，却让近处的视差变大、超出搜索范围，两张图的外观也差得更多。要紧的只是 f·b 的乘积，所以要在「近处配得上」和「远处够准」之间取舍。
body.en: A wider baseline or a longer lens makes far things more precise, but makes the disparity of near things bigger, past the search range, and the two images look more different too. Only the product f·b matters, so you trade off “near things still match” against “far things are precise enough”.

title.en: Epipolar lines and the fundamental matrix

body.zh: 真实的两台相机很难摆得正，同一点常跑到别的行。可左图的一个点只确定一条视线，这条视线上所有可能的深度，投到右图都落在同一条直线上，叫<part-ref to="own-7-7"></part-ref>。
body.en: Real cameras are rarely lined up exactly, so the same point often lands on a different row. But a point in the left image fixes only a line of sight, and every possible depth along it projects into the right image onto one straight line, called the <part-ref to="own-7-7"></part-ref>.

body.zh: 两台相机的相对位置可以事先标定，记成一个 3×3 的基础矩阵 F。左图点 p 的极线是 l′ = F·p，写成 a·u′ + b·v′ + c = 0；点落在线上的哪里，取决于它有多远。
body.en: The cameras’ relative position can be calibrated in advance and recorded as a 3×3 fundamental matrix F. The epipolar line of a left-image point p is l′ = F·p, written a·u′ + b·v′ + c = 0; where the point lands on that line depends on how far away it is.

body.zh: 于是二维搜索变成了一维，省下大量比较。所有极线都汇向同一点，叫极点。
body.en: So a 2-D search becomes 1-D, saving a great many comparisons. All the epipolar lines meet at one point, the epipole.

body.zh: 把整张图压成几个数 z，再从 z 画回一张图，训练目标就是输入自己，所以不需要标签。这样的一对叫自编码器。
body.en: An squeezes a whole image into a few numbers z, and a draws an image back from z; the training target is the input itself, so no labels are needed. Such a pair is called an autoencoder.

body.zh: 中间最窄的那层叫瓶颈。它至少要有图像真正变化的那么多个数：一族图只在左右、上下两个方向变，就至少要两个数，一个数只能让它沿一条线变化。
body.en: The narrowest layer in the middle is the bottleneck. It needs at least as many numbers as the ways the images really vary: a family of images that varies only left–right and up–down needs at least two numbers, since one number can only move along a single line.

body.zh: 压缩、去噪都从这一步开始。
body.en: Compression and denoising both start from this step.

body.zh: 从正态分布里随机抽 z 交给解码器，就能画出没见过的图，这就是生成。随机不是乱来：数大多落在中心 μ 附近，σ 越大越散。VAE（变分自编码器）的编码器给出的就是 μ 和 σ。
body.en: Draw z at random from a normal distribution and hand it to the decoder, and you can draw pictures never seen before: this is generation. Random does not mean arbitrary: the numbers mostly fall near the centre μ, more spread out the larger σ is. In a VAE (variational autoencoder), the encoder outputs this μ and σ.

body.zh: 可随机抽样这一步没法求导：每次重抽，训练分不清结果变好是因为改了 μ、σ 还是运气。重参数化把它写成 z = μ + σ·ε，随机全部来自输入 ε，z 对 μ、σ 就只是乘和加，梯度清清楚楚。
body.en: But the random sampling step cannot be differentiated: with a fresh draw each time, training cannot tell whether a better result came from changing μ and σ or from luck. Reparameterisation writes it as z = μ + σ·ε: all the randomness comes from the input ε, z is just a multiply and an add of μ and σ, and the gradient is perfectly clear.

body.zh: VAE 就是这样训练的；Stable Diffusion 里负责压缩和还原图像的部分，训练时也要用到它。
body.en: That is how a VAE is trained, and the part of Stable Diffusion that compresses and restores images relies on it during training too.

body.zh: 生成对抗网络（GAN）让两个模型对练：生成器画假样本，鉴定员（判别器）判断真假。鉴定员越会认，生成器就得画得越像。
body.en: A generative adversarial network (GAN) sets two models against each other: the generator draws fake samples and the judge (the discriminator) tells real from fake. The better the judge gets, the more convincing the generator has to be.

body.zh: 理想的结局是生成器画出的分布和真实数据一样，鉴定员只能瞎猜，准确率回到 50%。
body.en: Ideally the generator ends up drawing the same distribution as the real data, so the judge can only guess and its accuracy is back to 50%.

body.zh: 常见的失败是模式坍塌：真实数据有好几堆，生成器画出的样本却只覆盖其中一堆。
body.en: A common failure is mode collapse: the real data has several clusters, but the generator’s samples cover only one of them.

body.zh: 响应图过了门槛是一片一片的，一个角、一只狗附近好几格都很强。非极大值抑制只留下比周围都不小的那一格：先算出每格周围 3×3 的最大值，再看自己是不是等于它。
body.en: Above a threshold a response map comes in patches: several cells round one corner or one dog are all strong. Non-maximum suppression keeps only the cell no smaller than everything around it: work out the largest value in the 3×3 round each cell, then check whether the cell equals it.

body.zh: 3×3 的最大值可以先横后竖分两步算，和可分离的模糊一样。角点检测、Hough 找线、目标检测的最后一步都用它。
body.en: The 3×3 maximum can be taken across then down in two steps, like a separable blur. Corner detection, finding lines with Hough and object detection all end with it.

title.en: Homogeneous coordinates and the cross product

body.zh: 齐次坐标把点 (x, y) 写成三个数 (x, y, 1)，把直线 ax + by + c = 0 写成 (a, b, c)。点在线上，就是两组数点乘为 0。
body.en: Homogeneous coordinates write the point (x, y) as three numbers (x, y, 1) and the line ax + by + c = 0 as (a, b, c). A point lies on a line exactly when their dot product is 0.

body.zh: 两个点的<part-ref to="own-7-5"></part-ref>是过它们的直线，两条直线的叉积是它们的交点 (X, Y, W)，表示 (X/W, Y/W)；平行线 W = 0，交在无穷远。
body.en: The <part-ref to="own-7-5"></part-ref> of two points is the line through them, and of two lines the point where they meet, (X, Y, W), standing for (X/W, Y/W); parallel lines have W = 0 and meet at infinity.

body.zh: 扩散模型先学会反方向：把一张图一步步加噪，x_t = √ᾱ·x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ)·ε，ᾱ 从 1 降到 0，图就没进噪声里。两次加噪等于按 ᾱ 相乘的一次，所以训练时能一步跳到任意一步。
body.en: A diffusion model first learns the other direction: noise is added step by step, x_t = √ᾱ·x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ)·ε, and as ᾱ falls from 1 to 0 the picture sinks into the noise. Two rounds of noise equal one with the ᾱ multiplied, so training can jump straight to any step.

body.zh: 网络学的是看着 x_t 猜出 ε；知道了噪声，x₀ = (x_t − √(1 − ᾱ)·ε) / √ᾱ。生成时从纯噪声出发，一步步猜噪声、去掉一点，最后得到一张没见过的图。
body.en: The network learns to guess ε from x_t; knowing the noise, x₀ = (x_t − √(1 − ᾱ)·ε) / √ᾱ. To generate, it starts from pure noise and, step after step, guesses the noise and removes a little, until a picture never seen before appears.

body.zh: 分割要给每个像素一个答案，网络缩小以后还得放大回来。转置卷积先补零放大一倍，再用一个核填满空格：核决定空格从哪些邻居、按什么比例取数，可以学。
body.en: Segmentation gives an answer for every pixel, so after shrinking, a network has to enlarge again. A transposed convolution zero-upsamples to twice the size, then fills the gaps with a kernel, which decides which neighbours fill each gap and in what proportion, and can be learnt.

body.zh: 最大反池化把池化时留下的最大值放回它原来的那一格，其余是 0，细节不会被抹到整块上。
body.en: Max unpooling puts each maximum kept by pooling back in the cell it came from, with the rest 0, so details are not smeared over a whole block.

body.zh: k 均值不用标签就把数据分成 k 堆：先定 k 个中心，每个点归到最近的中心，再把每个中心挪到自己那一堆的平均，重复到不再变。
body.en: k-means splits data into k heaps without labels: choose k centres, give every point to its nearest centre, move each centre to the average of its heap, and repeat until nothing changes.

body.zh: 按亮度分两堆时，分界就在两个中心正中间。它只看给它的特征：只给亮度，亮度一样的两样东西就分不开；把位置也当成特征，就得到超像素（SLIC）。
body.en: Splitting into two by brightness, the boundary sits halfway between the two centres. It only sees the features it is given: with brightness alone, two things of the same brightness cannot be told apart; add position as a feature and you get superpixels (SLIC).

body.zh: 编码器—解码器先缩小再放大：缩小时几格合起来看，噪声互相抵消，看得到大的结构；放大回来时，比一块还细的东西已经丢了。
body.en: An encoder–decoder shrinks, then enlarges: shrinking looks at several cells together, so noise cancels and large structure shows; but when enlarged back, anything finer than a block is already gone.

body.zh: 跳连把编码器里原尺寸的结果直接接到解码器：粗的一路挡噪声，细的一路留细节。U-Net 每一层都这样连，细胞分割、医学图像都离不开它。
body.en: A skip connection wires the encoder's full-size result straight to the decoder: the coarse path keeps out noise, the fine path keeps detail. U-Net connects every level like this, and cell and medical image segmentation depend on it.

body.zh: <part-ref to="own-10-1"></part-ref>（交并比）= 两个框交集的面积 ÷ 并集的面积，0 到 1。检测出的框和标注的框 IoU 大于 0.5（VOC），才算找对。
body.en: <part-ref to="own-10-1"></part-ref> (intersection over union) = the area where two boxes overlap ÷ the area they cover together, from 0 to 1. A detected box counts as right when its IoU with the labelled box is above 0.5 (VOC).

body.zh: 把检测结果按分数排好，第 k 名的精确率 = 前 k 名里对的个数 ÷ k；AP 是每个对的那一名的精确率加起来，再除以标注的个数，也就是精确率—召回率曲线下的面积。各类 AP 的平均是 mAP。
body.en: Sort the detections by score: the precision at rank k = the number right in the top k ÷ k, and AP is the precisions at the right ones, added up and divided by the number labelled: the area under the precision–recall curve. The average AP over the classes is mAP.

body.zh: 滑窗检测拿一个模板在图上逐位置打分，再过门槛、做非极大值抑制。大小不同的东西，在缩小的图上用同一个检测器找（图像金字塔），结果放大回来合并。
body.en: Sliding-window detection scores a template at every position of the picture, then thresholds and applies non-maximum suppression. Things of other sizes are found with the same detector on shrunken copies (an image pyramid), and the results are enlarged back and merged.

body.zh: 现代检测器在每个位置放几个锚框，再回归四个修正：中心挪 t × 锚框的宽高，宽高乘 e^t。Faster R-CNN、YOLO 都这样做，成绩用 IoU 和 mAP 来量。
body.en: Modern detectors place a few anchors at every position and regress four corrections: the centre moves by t × the anchor's width or height, and the size is multiplied by e^t. Faster R-CNN and YOLO both work like this, and are scored with IoU and mAP.

body.zh: 分类器答对了，不等于它看对了地方：训练集里车总在路上，只认路也能全对。这种捷径要靠检查模型在看哪里才发现得了。
body.en: A classifier that answers right has not necessarily looked in the right place: in a training set where cars always stand on roads, recognising the road alone gets everything right. Such a shortcut is only found by checking where the model looks.

body.zh: 遮挡实验拿一块挡板在图上逐格移动，记下每个位置挡住后分数掉了多少，画成热图。它不需要知道模型里面是什么，CNN、ViT 都能用，代价是每个位置都要重跑一遍模型。挡板常用灰色（数据集的平均色），大小要和物体的部件相当。
body.en: The occlusion experiment slides a patch over the picture cell by cell, notes how far the score drops with each place covered, and draws that as a heat map. It needs nothing from inside the model and works for a CNN or a ViT, at the price of running the model again for every position. The patch is usually grey (the dataset's average colour), and about the size of the object's parts.

body.zh: Grad-CAM 只跑一次：用分数对最后一层卷积特征图的梯度，给每个通道一个权重，把特征图加权相加，再过 ReLU 只留支持这个类别的部分。ViT 则可以看类别 token 的注意力落在哪些图块上，但要把各层、各头合起来看（attention rollout），单看一个头容易被骗。
body.en: Grad-CAM runs the model once: the gradient of the score with respect to the last convolutional feature maps gives each channel a weight, the maps are added with those weights, and a ReLU keeps only what supports the class. For a ViT one can look at which patches the class token attends to, but the layers and heads have to be combined (attention rollout); a single head alone is easily misleading.
